title: Axionvera SDK Smoke Test Configuration
description: JSON Schema for contributor-safe SDK smoke test runs. Defaults to mocked mode; live mode requires explicit maintainer flag.

network.description: Network to run against. 'mock' means no RPC calls.

rpcUrl.description: Custom RPC URL (optional; inferred from network preset when omitted).

mode.description: Execution mode. 'mocked' and 'dry-run' are safe for contributors. 'live' is maintainer-only.

contracts.description: Map of logical contract name to smoke test requirements.

contractId.description: Soroban contract ID (56-char 'C...') or 'PLACEHOLDER_' prefix for dev-only.

requiredMethods.description: Methods that must be callable in this smoke test.

readArgs.description: Optional argument map for read-only methods (methodName -> args array).

writeDisabled.description: If true (default), write methods are simulated only; never submitted to a live network.

wallet.description: Optional wallet configuration. Secret is NEVER hardcoded; set via env var AXIONVERA_TEST_SECRET.

useMock.description: Use MockWalletConnector (true) or require wallet connector provider (false, maintainer-only).

dryRun.description: If true (default), print the plan but do not execute any write submissions.

outputFile.description: Optional path to write JSON report output.
